summary_1line: Narrative describes cosmic creation by Krishna/Govinda, the birth of Brahma, slaying of Madhu, genealogies of sages and beings, and origins of social orders and ages.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vishnu floats upon the primeval ocean as a radiant lotus grows from his navel and the shining Brahma rises from it.
The Supreme Being slays the dark Asura Madhu as the newly born Brahma is threatened beside the cosmic waters.
From Krishna’s body emerge the four orders of humanity—Brahmanas from his mouth, Kshatriyas from his arms, Vaisyas from his thighs, and Sudras from his feet.
